create_AutoencoderDC: create an AutoencoderDC instance with a SanaVAEConfig for 32x spatial compression
encode_images: encode images into latent space using the AutoencoderDC encode method
decode_latents: decode latent tensors back to image space using the AutoencoderDC decode method
load_model_weights: load model weights into AutoencoderDC using the load_weights method for deferred loading
load_state_dict: load a state dictionary into the AutoencoderDC inner diffusers model
